indications: Dicyclomine  hydrochloride tablets  are indicated for the treatment of patients with functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome.
contraindications: Dosage must be adjusted to individual patient needs.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Dicyclomine hydrochloride tablets USP, 20 mg are available as light blue to blue, speckled, round, unscored,           flat-faced, beveled-edge tablets, debossed  ‘˄’ and ‘A2’ on one side and plain on the other side. They are supplied as follows: 
                   Blistercards of 30, NDC 0615-8622-39
 

                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F); excursions permitted between 15° to 30°C (59° to 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Protect from light.
adverseReactions:
Dicyclomine hydrochloride is contraindicated in infants less than 6 months of age 
       
 
  [see Use in Specific Populations (
                     
                        8.4
                     
                     )], nursing mothers 
       
 
  [see Use in Specific Populations (
                     
                        8.3
                     
                     )], and in patients with:
